ctaHeading: Campbellfield's refrigeration pros are ready — let's cool your supermarket.
aboutText: Based in Campbellfield, Supermarket Refrigeration Australia has been providing energy-efficient refrigeration solutions for over 20 years. We specialise in transcritical CO₂ systems and custom installations for supermarkets across Australia. From our Campbellfield headquarters, we serve clients nationwide with tailored services including ice machine compliance and eco-friendly upgrades.
servicesText: We offer comprehensive refrigeration services including installations, maintenance, and upgrades. Specialising in transcritical CO₂ systems, we help supermarkets reduce energy costs and environmental impact. From ice machines to coldrooms, we've got your cooling needs covered.
